overall_decision: 可接收为待核验采集成果；不能直接作为正式可执行规划数据
interpretation_notes: No duplicate primary keys or broken nonblank typed foreign keys found; blank optional keys are separately reported as readiness gaps.
48 blank verified_at values in candidate supplies reflect a dictionary conflict: observation time and verification time must be separate; do not fabricate verification timestamps.
36 whole-record sentinel entries use * or record, which are convention mismatches, not missing business fields.
All 464 change_type values differ from the workbook dictionary; preserve raw history and map with explicit rules rather than deleting logs.
All 116 rights_status values are public_view_only. This review reads the existing metadata, and does not independently determine legal permissions.
59 source records declare evidence paths and hashes. The attachment alone does not prove those evidence files have been delivered; 57 sources lack both fields.
Only read-only workbook and current repository contract checks were performed; no source URL or POI was independently reverified.
The member-1-only handoff note predates the supplied workbook; the actual workbook has food data and a populated change log.
No aux_secondary_claims worksheet is present in this attachment; this does not establish whether auxiliary material exists in another handoff package.

recommendations.decision: Recommend separate collection table 22_ticket_prices; do not implement or migrate runtime schema in this review.
recommendations.runtime_note: Current engine PlaceCost supports a cost envelope per place, not a full ticket-product catalog. Select an evidenced applicable ticket before converting amounts to fen.

recommendations.decision: Identity/description in 13; undated regular start-time claims may remain in notes; never synthesize dated 14 records.

Normalize change_type to create/update/delete/merge/status_change with raw type retained; normalize whole-record sentinels by agreed contract; resolve 47 blank evidence references for mechanical changes without inventing evidence.

Create or reconcile distinct physical vendor locations in places and link vendor.place_id; never use the parent scenic or market as an exact branch location; factories and brands need a real dine-in branch before being treated as meal stops.

Keep candidate/pending_review/conflict in staging; runtime validation has only unverified/verified and separate business_status. Do not silently collapse conflict, cancellation or expiry; retain status reasons and enforce applicability.
Separate observed_at/accessed_at from verified_at. Workbook supply dictionary currently mixes their meanings.

03!F14 counts verified against approval_status even though allowed approval values do not include verified. Count approved/retained with an audit-specific label; rename total counts currently labeled candidate or count statuses explicitly. Formulas have no cached results.
src_000055 is explicitly a user-reported customer-service reply. Preserve that provenance; do not silently promote field_check to independently witnessed field evidence.

or_000007 is marked expired because obsolete OTA content was invalidated, while its date range is still future. Distinguish invalidation/supersession from time expiry; record the replacement and do not infer future applicability.
src_000100 has a date-only published_at value while the dictionary/runtime expects datetime. Preserve date precision in staging; do not invent a publication time.

integration_mapping_examples.source_type_provider: map_service only when actually a map provider; otherwise other with original subtype retained
integration_mapping_examples.food_street: requires explicit product classification; never auto-classify an entire street as one restaurant
